title: Energy Marshal
description:
**Energy Marshal**
==================

**Location:** Conesville, OH  
**Duration:** 12 Months (Start: 11/16)  
**Type:** 1099 Contractor

**CompensationSchedule**
------------------------

**Pay Rate:** $77/hr  
**Per Diem:** $150/Day  
**Pay Frequency:** Weekly  
**Schedule:** Monday-Friday | 6:30 AM - 4:30 PM

**Why This Opportunity?**
-------------------------

Provide Energy Marshal leadership for a **complex electrical construction project** in Conesville, OH. Project scope includes **energization readiness, LV and MV electrical distribution systems, switching activities, LOTO, NETA acceptance testing, commissioning, and equipment turnover**.

The Energy Marshal will lead energization readiness reviews, perform technical reviews of MOPs and switching plans, verify LOTO readiness, track deficiencies, and make documented **Go/No-Go energization decisions** within delegated authority.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

Minimum 10+ Years of Experience Working with Electrical Contractors  
Previous Energy Marshal Experience on a Data Center Project Required  
NFPA 70E Training / Electrical Safety Experience Required  
Experience with LV and MV Electrical Distribution Systems  
Experience with NETA Acceptance Testing  
Experience Supporting Electrical Commissioning Milestones and Equipment Turnover  
Experience Executing and Reviewing Electrical Methods of Procedure (MOPs)  
Experience with Electrical Switching Plans and Energization Activities  
Experience Verifying LOTO and Energy Isolation Readiness  
Strong Documentation, Communication, and Field Coordination Skills

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

Previous Energy Marshal or Equivalent Authority on a Hyperscale Data Center Project  
MV SwitchingGrounding Experience with Documented Task-Specific Qualifications  
Experience with NETA Acceptance Testing, Electrical Commissioning Milestones, and Equipment Turnover

title: Data Center Chief Engineer Night Role
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Join our dynamic Data Center Engineering Operations Team and become a critical architect of the infrastructure that powers global cloud computing. You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of Amazon Web Services' physical infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that support millions of customers worldwide.  
The Data Center Chief Engineer (CE) is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves both planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response to emergent issues. The CE serves as an expert technical resource reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager, interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third-party vendors. They are expected to be a singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center and to support Amazon within its owned and operated data centers. Data center equipment that supports mission-critical servers must maintain better than 99.999% uptime.  
Chief Engineer will be responsible for managing small-to-medium large impact projects from conception to completion. These projects can involve large amounts of independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in both local and global settings. The CE will be tasked with creating and delivering milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities. The goals of such projects are for the CE to drive innovation and resiliency while reducing operational costs in the facilities.
